item.text:
**5B.10 Research Note**
Overall, I’d rate 2024 as **modestly positive on economic trajectory, but mixed on competence/honesty**. Brazil ended the year with stronger real activity than it started with, yet fiscal credibility and FX stability deteriorated, and some of that stress was clearly driven by external constraints like tight global money, drought, and commodity swings.

**Evidence for “yes, stronger trajectory”**
- **Brazil’s economy grew 3.4% in 2024, strongest since the post-pandemic rebound** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2025-03-07 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-economy-grows-34-in-2024-02-in-q4-3914729) | Annual GDP growth outpaced 2023’s 2.9%, and the Reuters report says investment and household consumption were strong, suggesting Lula left the economy on a better real-growth path even though Q4 slowed under restrictive rates. | `5B.10`, `5B.9`
- **Unemployment fell to a decade-low range while inflation was still contained mid-year** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-07-04 | [link](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/07/04/lula-diz-que-inflacao-esta-sob-controle-e-comemora-desemprego-baixo.htm) | IBGE data cited in the Reuters report showed unemployment at 7.1% in the three months to May, the lowest since 2014/2015, with inflation at 3.93% over 12 months to May, supporting a better 2024 trajectory than a collapsing macro picture. | `5B.10`, `5B.9`
- **The IMF judged Brazil resilient and said inflation had receded into the target band** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-05-28 | [link](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/05/28/fmi-diz-que-flexibilidade-do-brasil-no-ritmo-de-afrouxamento-monetario-e-prudente.htm) | The IMF said Brazil had shown notable resilience over the prior two years, with inflation receding back into the target range, and treated cautious monetary easing as appropriate given a tight labor market and still-elevated inflation expectations. | `5B.10`, `5B.9`
- **The inherited economy was slowing, but not in collapse** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-03-01 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/brazils-economy-up-29-in-2023-but-stagnates-in-q4-3321586) | Brazil finished 2023 with 2.9% growth, but Q4 stagnation and weak early-2024 forecasts show Lula inherited a slowing economy, which makes the 2024 growth outturn more favorable relative to baseline. | `5B.10`

**Evidence for “no / mixed”**
- **Fiscal management was under strain and required repeated spending freezes** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-07-18 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazil-freezes-27-billion-from-2024-budget-after-market-turmoil-3526146) | Haddad announced a R$15 billion freeze after market turmoil to try to hit the fiscal target, which shows active correction but also reactive management and weakening confidence. | `5B.10`, `5B.9`
- **Year-end currency weakness points to deteriorating credibility** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-16 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/lula-slams-interest-rate-levels-as-the-only-thing-wrong-with-brazil-3773862) | Reuters reported the real hit a record low and had fallen about one-fifth in 2024 as markets worried about spending, which is strong counterevidence to a clean “stronger trajectory” verdict. | `5B.10`, `5B.9`
- **Reuters said the government relied on creative accounting to meet targets** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-18 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysisbrazils-tinkering-to-meet-fiscal-target-threatens-to-dent-credibility-3620814) | This is the sharpest negative item on honesty: the report says Brasília used increasingly creative accounting around spending, tax exemptions, and revenue to hit targets, weakening fiscal-rule credibility. | `5B.10`, `5B.9`
- **Lula’s central-bank pressure added uncertainty** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-07-01 | [link](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/07/01/lula-critica-bc-autonomo-e-diz-que-autoridade-monetaria-nao-atende-populacao.htm) | Lula publicly pressed the central bank to look beyond financial-market preferences, which may have had political appeal but also worsened credibility and market pricing. | `5B.10`, `5B.9`
- **External shocks were real, especially drought and commodity volatility** | Reuters via UOL and Reuters via TradingView | 2024-09-24 / 2024-11-29 | [link1](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/09/24/campos-neto-alerta-que-seca-e-risco-para-precos-de-energia-e-alimentos.amp.htm) [link2](https://www.tradingview.com/news/reuters.com%2C2024%3Anewsml_L1N3NJ0M8%3A0-soybeans-plummet-to-four-year-low-on-brazil-crop-outlook/) | Drought was explicitly flagged as a risk to energy and food prices, while Brazil crop conditions were affecting global commodity prices; some of the macro stress was therefore external rather than purely Lula-generated. | `5B.10`

**Bottom line**
- **Real economy:** somewhat stronger by end-2024 than at the start.
- **Honesty/credibility:** mixed to weak, because fiscal-rule strain, creative accounting concerns, and central-bank pressure undercut confidence.
- **Overall call:** **moderate support, not a clean yes**.

**Search gap**
- I did not find strong Lula-specific 2024 evidence on **public debt dynamics** or **sanctions**, so the judgment here leans on GDP, inflation, unemployment, fiscal rules, FX, and shock-response evidence instead.
